item.title: 🟠 SAP Commerce Cloud Flaw Could Let Unauthenticated Attackers Execute Arbitrary Code
item.description:
Why this matters: Nation-state threat actor — elevated persistence and lateral movement risk.
SAP has released patches to address a maximum-severity security flaw impacting Commerce Cloud (Data Hub Adapter) that could result in arbitrary code execution. item.title: 🟠 ShieldBreak Zero-Day PoC Claims Microsoft Defender Patch Bypass With SYSTEM Access
item.description:
Why this matters: Endpoint detection changes — review high-severity detections and alert noise.

item.title: 🔴 Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.

Source: Krebs on Security  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 10h ago
